assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code for unspecified atrial fibrillation is I48.91.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis code for personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction is Z86.73.
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management.
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
CPT 93271 is distinct from other bundled procedures.
